description: This file defines the CashFlowValidations class which provides validation methods for cash flow related parameters in financial calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It extends the FinancialValidations class and includes methods to validate rate, period type, present value, and future value, throwing exceptions if validations fail.

classes.name: CashFlowValidations
classes.description: A class containing static methods to validate various cash flow parameters such as rate, period type, present value, and future value for financial calculations.

methods.name: validateRate
methods.description: Validates that the input is a float representing a rate.

methods.name: validatePeriodType
methods.description: Validates that the period type is either PAYMENT_END_OF_PERIOD or PAYMENT_BEGINNING_OF_PERIOD.

methods.name: validatePresentValue
methods.description: Validates that the present value is a float.

methods.name: validateFutureValue
methods.description: Validates that the future value is a float.
